```{r}
# Step 5: Toolbox 3 - random-forest HSM engine (spatial-block cross-validation, repeated)

# Accuracy on the held-out blocks: AUC-ROC (rank-based), AUC-PR (trapezoid over 101 cutoffs),
# and the cutoff that maximises sensitivity + specificity (as in the GEE case studies)
eval_hsm <- function(obs, pred) {
  n1 <- sum(obs == 1); n0 <- sum(obs == 0)
  auc.roc <- (sum(rank(pred)[obs == 1]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)

  cuts <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 101)
  tp   <- sapply(cuts, function(k) sum(pred > k & obs == 1))
  fp   <- sapply(cuts, function(k) sum(pred > k & obs == 0))
  sens <- tp / n1
  spec <- (n0 - fp) / n0
  prec <- ifelse(tp + fp == 0, 1, tp / (tp + fp))
  o    <- order(sens)
  auc.pr <- sum(diff(sens[o]) * (head(prec[o], -1) + tail(prec[o], -1)) / 2)
  best <- which.max(sens + spec)

  tibble(
    AUC.ROC = auc.roc, AUC.PR = auc.pr, Threshold = cuts[best],
    Sensitivity = sens[best], Specificity = spec[best], TSS = sens[best] + spec[best] - 1
  )
}

# Environmental profiling (Crego et al., Case study 1, option 3): cluster the presence cells into 2 groups,
# then only allow pseudo-absences in cells closer to the cluster the presences use LESS
env_dissimilar <- function(Cells, vars) {
  Z  <- scale(Cells[, vars, drop = FALSE])
  km <- kmeans(Z[Cells$Pres == 1, , drop = FALSE], centers = 2, nstart = 10)
  d  <- sapply(1:2, function(k) rowSums((Z - matrix(km$centers[k, ], nrow(Z), ncol(Z), byrow = TRUE))^2))
  cl <- max.col(-d)
  cl != which.max(tabulate(cl[Cells$Pres == 1], 2))
}

fit_hsm_rf <- function(Cells, pres_cells, vars, template, block_km, cfg, pa_method = "random") {

  Cells$Pres  <- as.integer(Cells$cell %in% pres_cells)
  Cells$Block <- paste(floor((Cells$x - min(Cells$x)) / (block_km * 1000)),
                       floor((Cells$y - min(Cells$y)) / (block_km * 1000)))

  Candidates <- Cells[Cells$Pres == 0, ]                     # pseudo-absences never fall in a presence cell
  if (pa_method == "envprofile") Candidates <- Candidates[env_dissimilar(Cells, vars)[Cells$Pres == 0], ]

  cat(sprintf("Presences: %d | candidate pseudo-absence cells: %d | spatial blocks: %d (%d km)\n",
              sum(Cells$Pres), nrow(Candidates), length(unique(Cells$Block)), block_km))

  Seeds   <- rep_len(cfg$Seeds, cfg$N.Iter)
  Preds   <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(Cells), cfg$N.Iter)
  Metrics <- list(); Importance <- list(); Models <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(cfg$N.Iter)) {

    # Random split of BLOCKS into training / testing; redraw until both hold enough presences
    for (attempt in 0:99) {
      set.seed(Seeds[i] + 1000 * attempt)
      blocks   <- unique(Cells$Block)
      tr.block <- blocks[runif(length(blocks)) < cfg$Split]
      n.tr     <- sum(Cells$Pres == 1 &  Cells$Block %in% tr.block)
      n.te     <- sum(Cells$Pres == 1 & !Cells$Block %in% tr.block)
      if (n.tr >= 10 && n.te >= 5) break
    }
    if (attempt == 99) stop("Could not split the presences across training and testing blocks - use smaller blocks")

    # Presences capped at Max.Train; pseudo-absences: as many as presences, drawn separately inside training and testing blocks
    draw    <- function(rows, n) rows[sample(nrow(rows), min(n, nrow(rows))), ]
    Pres.tr <- draw(Cells[Cells$Pres == 1 &  Cells$Block %in% tr.block, ], cfg$Max.Train)
    Pres.te <- draw(Cells[Cells$Pres == 1 & !Cells$Block %in% tr.block, ], cfg$Max.Train)
    Train <- rbind(Pres.tr, draw(Candidates[ Candidates$Block %in% tr.block, ], nrow(Pres.tr)))
    Test  <- rbind(Pres.te, draw(Candidates[!Candidates$Block %in% tr.block, ], nrow(Pres.te)))

    rf <- ranger::ranger(
      x = Train[, vars, drop = FALSE], y = factor(Train$Pres, levels = c(0, 1)),
      num.trees = cfg$N.Trees, probability = TRUE, min.node.size = 10, sample.fraction = 0.5,
      importance = "permutation", seed = Seeds[i]
    )

    Metrics[[i]]    <- eval_hsm(Test$Pres, predict(rf, Test[, vars, drop = FALSE])$predictions[, "1"]) |> mutate(Run = i)
    Importance[[i]] <- tibble(Variable = names(rf$variable.importance), Importance = rf$variable.importance, Run = i)
    Preds[, i]      <- predict(rf, Cells[, vars, drop = FALSE])$predictions[, "1"]
    Models[[i]]     <- rf
  }

  to_raster <- function(v) { r <- rast(template); values(r) <- NA; r[Cells$cell] <- v; r }
  Metrics   <- bind_rows(Metrics)

  list(
    HSI        = to_raster(rowMeans(Preds)),
    HSI.SD     = to_raster(apply(Preds, 1, sd)),
    Metrics    = Metrics,
    Importance = bind_rows(Importance) |> group_by(Variable) |> summarise(Importance = mean(Importance), .groups = "drop") |> arrange(desc(Importance)),
    Threshold  = mean(Metrics$Threshold),
    Models     = Models,
    Vars       = vars,
    Cells      = Cells
  )
}

# Partial dependence: how mean HSI changes along one predictor with the others held at their observed values
partial_dependence <- function(Fit, top_n = 6, n_grid = 15, n_rows = 500, n_models = 3) {
  set.seed(1)
  Base <- Fit$Cells[sample(nrow(Fit$Cells), min(n_rows, nrow(Fit$Cells))), Fit$Vars, drop = FALSE]
  Vars <- head(Fit$Importance$Variable, top_n)

  bind_rows(lapply(Vars, function(v) {
    g <- unique(quantile(Fit$Cells[[v]], probs = seq(0.02, 0.98, length.out = n_grid)))
    tibble(
      Variable = v, Value = g,
      HSI = sapply(g, function(val) {
        b <- Base; b[[v]] <- val
        mean(sapply(head(Fit$Models, n_models), function(m) mean(predict(m, b)$predictions[, "1"])))
      })
    )
  }))
}
```

```{r}
# Step 6: Toolbox 4 - expert-prior index, zone summaries, maps, outputs

# Expert-prior index (used when there are too few precise records for a data-driven model)
  # Each predictor is turned into a 0-1 suitability with a trapezoid (0 below a, rising to 1 at b, 1 until c, falling to 0 at d)
  # Type "q": a-d are quantiles of the study area (NA = unbounded); type "abs": a-d are in the variable's own units
  # Cells are combined with a weighted geometric mean
  # ILLUSTRATIVE VALUES - to be reviewed by cheetah specialists (KWS, Tsavo Trust, ...) before use
Cheetah.Prior <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Variable,        ~Type, ~a,   ~b,   ~c,   ~d,   ~Weight, ~Rationale,
  "Trees",          "abs", -Inf, -Inf, 0.10, 0.50, 2.0,     "hunts by sight: avoids closed woody cover",
  "Shrubland",      "abs", -Inf, -Inf, 0.50, 0.95, 1.0,     "dense bush limits visibility (lenient: Tsavo is bushland)",
  "Grassland",      "abs", 0.00, 0.20, 1.00, 1.00, 1.5,     "open grassland / savanna = hunting habitat",
  "RPI.Mean",       "q",   0.10, 0.60, 1.00, 1.00, 1.5,     "productive rangeland supports gazelle / impala prey",
  "Slope_deg",      "abs", -Inf, -Inf, 3.00, 15.0, 1.0,     "avoids steep, rugged ground",
  "Pop_log10",      "q",   NA,   NA,   0.50, 0.95, 1.0,     "avoids dense human settlement",
  "Dist_Water_km",  "abs", -Inf, -Inf, 15,   40,   0.5,     "independent of water for days: weak effect"
)

trapezoid <- function(x, a, b, c, d) {
  ifelse(x <= a, 0, ifelse(x < b, (x - a) / (b - a), ifelse(x <= c, 1, ifelse(x < d, (d - x) / (d - c), 0))))
}

prior_hsi <- function(Cells, Prior, template) {
  Used <- Prior[Prior$Variable %in% names(Cells), ]
  cat("Prior uses:", paste(Used$Variable, collapse = ", "), "\n")

  logs <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(Used)), function(i) {
    p  <- Used[i, ]
    x  <- Cells[[p$Variable]]
    th <- unlist(p[, c("a", "b", "c", "d")])
    if (p$Type == "q") th <- ifelse(is.na(th), -Inf, quantile(x, th, na.rm = TRUE))
    log(pmax(trapezoid(x, th[1], th[2], th[3], th[4]), 0.01))        # floor: one poor variable does not zero a cell
  })

  r <- rast(template); values(r) <- NA
  r[Cells$cell] <- exp(as.vector(logs %*% Used$Weight) / sum(Used$Weight))
  names(r) <- "HSI"
  r
}

# Mean HSI and share of area above the threshold, per management unit
hsi_zone_summary <- function(HSI, threshold, zones, grain) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(zones), function(z) {
    v <- terra::extract(HSI, vect(st_transform(zones[[z]], crs(HSI))))[[2]]
    v <- v[!is.na(v)]
    tibble(
      Unit        = z,
      Area.km2    = length(v) * (grain / 1000)^2,
      Mean.HSI    = mean(v),
      Median.HSI  = median(v),
      Pct.Suitable = mean(v >= threshold) * 100,
      Suitable.km2 = sum(v >= threshold) * (grain / 1000)^2
    )
  }))
}

map_hsi <- function(HSI, title, overlay = NULL, pts = NULL) {
  m <- tm_shape(HSI) +
    tm_raster(
      col.scale  = tm_scale_continuous(values = "viridis", limits = c(0, 1)),
      col.legend = tm_legend(title = "HSI", reverse = TRUE)
    )
  if (!is.null(overlay)) m <- m + overlay
  if (!is.null(pts))     m <- m + tm_shape(pts) + tm_dots(fill = "red", size = 0.5)
  m + tm_title(title) + tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE) + tm_view(basemap.server = Basemaps)
}

save_hsm <- function(HSI, HSI.SD = NULL, binary = NULL, tag) {
  writeRaster(HSI, file.path(HSM.Dir.Out, paste0(tag, "_HSI_mean.tif")), overwrite = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(HSI.SD)) writeRaster(HSI.SD, file.path(HSM.Dir.Out, paste0(tag, "_HSI_sd.tif")), overwrite = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(binary)) writeRaster(binary,  file.path(HSM.Dir.Out, paste0(tag, "_suitable.tif")), overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("Saved to", HSM.Dir.Out, "\n")
}
```

### 5.1 Black rhino - Tsavo West NP

The presences are the occupied Rhino Range (`range_proxy`); the pseudo-absences are drawn from the rest of the park, outside the range. The result is the *similarity* of every 500 m cell to Ngulia + IPZ habitat.

```{r}
# Step 7: Rhino predictors

HSM.Template.Rhino <- make_hsm_template(HSM.AOI.Rhino, HSM.Config$Grain.m, HSM.Config$CRS)

HSM.Pred.Rhino <- build_hsm_predictors(
  HSM.Template.Rhino,
  dem_file = Data.Path("Terrain", "TsavoWest_DEM.tif"),
  tag      = "TW"
)

# One row per 500 m cell with every predictor present
HSM.Cells.Rhino <- as.data.frame(HSM.Pred.Rhino, cells = TRUE, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Rhino model cells: %d of %d study-area cells have every predictor (%.0f%%); the rest sit on NoData gaps in the source rasters and stay NA\n",
            nrow(HSM.Cells.Rhino), global(!is.na(HSM.Template.Rhino), "sum")[[1]], nrow(HSM.Cells.Rhino) / global(!is.na(HSM.Template.Rhino), "sum")[[1]] * 100))

# Drop highly collinear predictors. Human density is left out here: inside a park it mostly encodes position (edge vs core),
# so with 'range vs rest' presences it would only learn where the range is. The 5.5 km CHIRPS rainfall layers are left out for the
# same reason (only ~2 pixels cover the whole Rhino Range, so rainfall would just mark its position)
set.seed(42)
HSM.Vars.Rhino <- drop_collinear(HSM.Cells.Rhino, setdiff(HSM.Priority, c("Pop_log10", "rain_annual_mm", "rain_dry_mm", "rain_cv")), HSM.Config$Corr.Max)
cat("Predictors kept:", paste(HSM.Vars.Rhino, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Step 8: Rhino presences

# 8a. What does GBIF give us for black rhino here? (small, and mostly obscured - see the section introduction)
HSM.GBIF.Rhino <- get_gbif_occurrences(
  "Diceros bicornis", HSM.AOI.Rhino, HSM.Config$Year.Min,
  cache_file = file.path(HSM.Dir.Species, "gbif_rhino.csv")
)
HSM.Clean.Rhino <- clean_occurrences(HSM.GBIF.Rhino, HSM.Template.Rhino, HSM.Config)
print(HSM.Clean.Rhino$steps)

# 8b. Presences for the model: every cell of the occupied Rhino Range
HSM.Pres.Rhino <- range_proxy_cells(TsavoWest.Rhino.Range, HSM.Template.Rhino)
HSM.Pres.Rhino <- intersect(HSM.Pres.Rhino, HSM.Cells.Rhino$cell)
cat("Rhino presences (cells inside the Rhino Range):", length(HSM.Pres.Rhino), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Step 9: Rhino model - 10 repetitions, spatial blocks of 5 km

HSM.Fit.Rhino <- fit_hsm_rf(
  HSM.Cells.Rhino, HSM.Pres.Rhino, HSM.Vars.Rhino, HSM.Template.Rhino,
  block_km = 5, cfg = HSM.Config, pa_method = "random"
)

HSM.Fit.Rhino$Metrics |>
  summarise(across(c(AUC.ROC, AUC.PR, Sensitivity, Specificity, TSS, Threshold), list(mean = mean, sd = sd))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("Metric", "Stat"), names_sep = "_", values_to = "Value") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Stat, values_from = Value) |>
  print()
```

Reading the accuracy: with balanced presences and pseudo-absences, AUC-PR of about 0.5 is chance. Because the presences are one compact, managed block of habitat, a high AUC mainly says that the Rhino Range is environmentally distinct from the rest of the park; it does not validate the map as a prediction of where rhinos would choose to live.

```{r}
# Step 10: Rhino - what drives the HSI?

HSM.Fit.Rhino$Importance |>
  mutate(Variable = fct_reorder(Variable, Importance)) |>
  ggplot(aes(Importance, Variable)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c7fb8") +
  labs(title = "Black rhino HSM - permutation importance (mean of 10 runs)", x = "Importance", y = NULL) +
  theme_rpi()

HSM.PDP.Rhino <- partial_dependence(HSM.Fit.Rhino)

ggplot(HSM.PDP.Rhino, aes(Value, HSI)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, colour = "#2c7fb8") +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Black rhino HSM - response curves", x = "Predictor value", y = "Mean HSI") +
  theme_rpi()
```

```{r}
# Step 11: Rhino - suitability map and the expansion question

HSM.HSI.Rhino <- HSM.Fit.Rhino$HSI
HSM.Bin.Rhino <- HSM.HSI.Rhino >= HSM.Fit.Rhino$Threshold

Map.HSI.Rhino <- map_hsi(HSM.HSI.Rhino, "Black rhino habitat suitability (similarity to the Rhino Range)", overlay = TW.Overlay)
Map.HSI.Rhino

# Suitability per zone: does the expansion zone hold Rhino-Range-like habitat?
HSM.Summary.Rhino <- hsi_zone_summary(HSM.HSI.Rhino, HSM.Fit.Rhino$Threshold, HSM.Zones.Rhino, HSM.Config$Grain.m)
print(HSM.Summary.Rhino)
```

```{r}
# Step 12: Rhino - candidate expansion areas
  # Two views of the expansion zone, both limited to cells within 5 km of water (the water-access limit from Section 4B):
  #   Rhino-Range-like  = HSI above the model threshold
  #   Relatively best   = top 20% of HSI inside the expansion zone (useful because few cells pass the threshold)

Expansion.Zone <- vect(st_transform(TsavoWest.Excl.RhinoRange, crs(HSM.HSI.Rhino)))
HSI.Expansion  <- mask(HSM.HSI.Rhino, Expansion.Zone)

Water.OK <- if ("Dist_Water_km" %in% names(HSM.Pred.Rhino)) HSM.Pred.Rhino[["Dist_Water_km"]] <= 5 else HSI.Expansion >= 0
Top20.Threshold <- quantile(values(HSI.Expansion), 0.80, na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]

HSM.Candidates.Rhino <- ifel(HSI.Expansion >= HSM.Fit.Rhino$Threshold & Water.OK, 2,
                        ifel(HSI.Expansion >= Top20.Threshold & Water.OK, 1, NA))
names(HSM.Candidates.Rhino) <- "Candidate"

Cell.km2 <- (HSM.Config$Grain.m / 1000)^2

Candidate.Summary <- tibble(
  Class = c("Rhino-Range-like (HSI >= model threshold)", "Relatively best 20% of the expansion zone"),
  Cells = c(global(HSM.Candidates.Rhino == 2, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]],
            global(HSM.Candidates.Rhino == 1, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]])
) |>
  mutate(Area.km2 = Cells * Cell.km2)

cat(sprintf("Expansion zone modelled: %.0f km2 | model threshold: %.2f | top-20%% cut-off: %.2f\n",
            global(!is.na(HSI.Expansion), "sum")[[1]] * Cell.km2, HSM.Fit.Rhino$Threshold, Top20.Threshold))
print(Candidate.Summary)

tm_shape(HSM.Candidates.Rhino) +
  tm_raster(
    col.scale  = tm_scale_categorical(values = c("1" = "#fdae61", "2" = "darkgreen"),
                                      labels = c("Relatively best 20%", "Rhino-Range-like"), value.na = NA),
    col.legend = tm_legend(title = "Expansion habitat")
  ) +
  TW.Overlay +
  tm_title("Candidate rhino expansion habitat (within 5 km of water)") +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE) +
  tm_view(basemap.server = Basemaps)

save_hsm(HSM.HSI.Rhino, HSM.Fit.Rhino$HSI.SD, HSM.Bin.Rhino, tag = "rhino_TsavoWest")
write_csv(HSM.Fit.Rhino$Metrics, file.path(HSM.Dir.Out, "rhino_TsavoWest_metrics.csv"))
write_csv(HSM.Summary.Rhino,     file.path(HSM.Dir.Out, "rhino_TsavoWest_zone_summary.csv"))
write_csv(Candidate.Summary,     file.path(HSM.Dir.Out, "rhino_TsavoWest_expansion_candidates.csv"))
```

### 5.2 Cheetah - Tsavo Conservation Area

Cheetahs range widely across park boundaries, so the study area is the whole TCA (Kenya side). Precise cheetah records are the limiting factor: drop a CSV with `lon`, `lat` (and `year`, `uncertainty_m`) into `data/Species/cheetah_occurrences.csv` and the data-driven model switches on automatically once at least `Min.Presences` cleaned records are available. Until then the expert-prior index is mapped, and the few precise GBIF records are used as a reality check.

```{r}
# Step 13: Cheetah predictors

HSM.Template.Cheetah <- make_hsm_template(HSM.AOI.Cheetah, HSM.Config$Grain.m, HSM.Config$CRS)

# The DEM for the whole TCA is downloaded once (SRTM via elevatr, ~300 m) and cached
HSM.DEM.TCA <- Data.Path("Terrain", "TCA_DEM.tif")

if (!file.exists(HSM.DEM.TCA)) {
  cat("Downloading SRTM DEM for the Tsavo Conservation Area...\n")
  HSM.DEM.Raw <- elevatr::get_elev_raster(locations = st_transform(HSM.AOI.Cheetah, 4326), z = 9, clip = "bbox")
  writeRaster(rast(HSM.DEM.Raw), HSM.DEM.TCA, overwrite = TRUE)
}

HSM.Pred.Cheetah <- build_hsm_predictors(HSM.Template.Cheetah, dem_file = HSM.DEM.TCA, tag = "TCA")

HSM.Cells.Cheetah <- as.data.frame(HSM.Pred.Cheetah, cells = TRUE, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Cheetah model cells: %d of %d study-area cells have every predictor (%.0f%%); the rest are NA (e.g. non-rangeland in StudyPixels)\n",
            nrow(HSM.Cells.Cheetah), global(!is.na(HSM.Template.Cheetah), "sum")[[1]], nrow(HSM.Cells.Cheetah) / global(!is.na(HSM.Template.Cheetah), "sum")[[1]] * 100))

set.seed(42)
HSM.Vars.Cheetah <- drop_collinear(HSM.Cells.Cheetah, HSM.Priority, HSM.Config$Corr.Max)
cat("Predictors kept:", paste(HSM.Vars.Cheetah, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Step 14: Cheetah presences - supplied records first, otherwise GBIF

HSM.Occ.File.Cheetah <- file.path(HSM.Dir.Species, "cheetah_occurrences.csv")

if (file.exists(HSM.Occ.File.Cheetah)) {
  HSM.Occ.Cheetah <- read_supplied_occurrences(HSM.Occ.File.Cheetah)
  cat("Using supplied records:", HSM.Occ.File.Cheetah, "\n")
} else {
  HSM.Occ.Cheetah <- get_gbif_occurrences(
    "Acinonyx jubatus", HSM.AOI.Cheetah, HSM.Config$Year.Min,
    cache_file = file.path(HSM.Dir.Species, "gbif_cheetah.csv")
  )
  cat("No supplied records found - using GBIF\n")
}

HSM.Clean.Cheetah <- clean_occurrences(HSM.Occ.Cheetah, HSM.Template.Cheetah, HSM.Config)
print(HSM.Clean.Cheetah$steps)

HSM.Pres.Cheetah <- intersect(HSM.Clean.Cheetah$points$cell, HSM.Cells.Cheetah$cell)
HSM.Mode.Cheetah <- if (length(HSM.Pres.Cheetah) >= HSM.Config$Min.Presences) "occurrences" else "prior"
cat(sprintf("Precise presences available: %d (minimum %d) -> mode: %s\n",
            length(HSM.Pres.Cheetah), HSM.Config$Min.Presences, HSM.Mode.Cheetah))
```

```{r}
# Step 15: Cheetah model
  # 'occurrences' -> random forest with spatial-block cross-validation (same engine as the rhino)
  # 'prior'       -> expert-prior index (Cheetah.Prior, Step 6)

if (HSM.Mode.Cheetah == "occurrences") {

  HSM.Fit.Cheetah <- fit_hsm_rf(
    HSM.Cells.Cheetah, HSM.Pres.Cheetah, HSM.Vars.Cheetah, HSM.Template.Cheetah,
    block_km = 20, cfg = HSM.Config, pa_method = "random"
  )
  HSM.HSI.Cheetah <- HSM.Fit.Cheetah$HSI
  HSM.Thr.Cheetah <- HSM.Fit.Cheetah$Threshold
  print(summarise(HSM.Fit.Cheetah$Metrics, across(c(AUC.ROC, AUC.PR, TSS), mean)))

} else {

  HSM.HSI.Cheetah <- prior_hsi(HSM.Cells.Cheetah, Cheetah.Prior, HSM.Template.Cheetah)

  # No validated threshold exists in this mode: 'suitable' = the best third of the study area
  HSM.Thr.Cheetah <- quantile(values(HSM.HSI.Cheetah), 0.67, na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]
  cat(sprintf("EXPERT-PRIOR MODE: HSI is illustrative and unvalidated; 'suitable' = HSI >= %.2f (top third)\n", HSM.Thr.Cheetah))

  # Reality check: where do the precise records fall on the HSI distribution? (0.5 = no better than chance)
  if (!is.null(HSM.Clean.Cheetah$points) && nrow(HSM.Clean.Cheetah$points) > 0) {
    at.pts <- terra::extract(HSM.HSI.Cheetah, vect(HSM.Clean.Cheetah$points))[[2]]
    cat(sprintf("Reality check: %d precise records sit, on average, at percentile %.0f of the HSI distribution (50 = chance)\n",
                sum(!is.na(at.pts)), mean(ecdf(values(HSM.HSI.Cheetah))(at.pts), na.rm = TRUE) * 100))
  }
}

HSM.Bin.Cheetah <- HSM.HSI.Cheetah >= HSM.Thr.Cheetah
```

```{r}
# Step 16: Cheetah - suitability map and suitability per management unit

TCA.Overlay <- tm_shape(HSM.Zones.Cheetah.sf) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "white", fill_alpha = 0, col = "black", lwd = 1.5, id = "NAME")

Map.HSI.Cheetah <- map_hsi(
  HSM.HSI.Cheetah,
  paste0("Cheetah habitat suitability - Tsavo Conservation Area (", HSM.Mode.Cheetah, " mode)"),
  overlay = TCA.Overlay
)
Map.HSI.Cheetah

HSM.Summary.Cheetah <- hsi_zone_summary(HSM.HSI.Cheetah, HSM.Thr.Cheetah, HSM.Zones.Cheetah, HSM.Config$Grain.m)
print(HSM.Summary.Cheetah)

save_hsm(HSM.HSI.Cheetah, binary = HSM.Bin.Cheetah, tag = paste0("cheetah_TCA_", HSM.Mode.Cheetah))
write_csv(HSM.Summary.Cheetah, file.path(HSM.Dir.Out, paste0("cheetah_TCA_", HSM.Mode.Cheetah, "_zone_summary.csv"))) 
```

### 5.3 Exporting extra predictors from Google Earth Engine (optional)

The models above run on the layers already in this project. Rainfall (CHIRPS), vegetation greenness (MODIS NDVI) and surface-water distance (JRC) are exported from GEE with `scripts/gee/01_TCA_HSM_predictors_export.js`, using the same convention as the Amaka and Kitobo projects:

1. Open the script in the GEE Code Editor (account `ee-imnduta1`) and save it as `users/imnduta1/Ismurn/TsavoHSM/01_TCA_HSM_predictors_export`.
2. Run it: it queues three `Export.image.toDrive` tasks (EPSG:32737, each product at its native scale, `maxPixels` 1e10, GeoTIFF). Start each from the **Tasks** tab.
3. The files appear in the Drive folder `TsavoHSM_GEE_Exports/`. Download them into `data/gee_exports/`.
4. Re-run Steps 7 and 13: `build_hsm_predictors()` picks the files up automatically (adds rainfall, rainfall variability, NDVI, and replaces the stream-based water distance with distance to JRC surface water).

### 5.4 Next steps

- **Real cheetah and rhino records** (KWS / AWF / SMART / camera traps / collars) are the biggest upgrade: they switch both species to a fully data-driven, validated model.
- **Movement and connectivity**: the cheetah HSI can be inverted into a resistance surface (`1 - HSI`) for least-cost corridors between the parks (`gdistance` or `circuitscape`).
- **Time**: the GEE case study 2 matches each record to the closest-in-time image. The RPI stack has 23 yearly layers, so the same idea can be applied here once records have dates.
